rules.name: Armour of Selket
rules.description: The Phase in which this unit successfully casts a Psychic Power that is not a Psychic Weapon, this unit gains a 3+ Invulnerable save until the end of the Phase.

rules.name: Slayer of Witches
rules.description: Once per game, Sevrin Loth can automatically pass the Psychic Test required to activate the Force special rule. In addition, Sevrin Loth gains the Hatred (Psykers) and while engaged in a combat with a unit which contains a Psyker, gains the Precision Hits special rule on his Force Axe but must allocate all hits to a target enemy Psyker first.

rules.name: Vexilla Imperialis Standard
rules.description: Friendly Space Marines units within 12” of the Banner can re-roll Pinning and Panic tests. In addition, when calculating the number of wounds caused in a combat for the purpose of determining if a unit within 12” of a model with this wargear has won or lost a combat, add 2 to the number of wounds caused by friendly Space Marine units within 12” of a model with this wargear.

rules.name: Split Command
rules.description: This unit is purchased as a single option but during deployment is deployed as two separate units. The models are treated as two separate units with the Character special rule after deployment is concluded. If this unit is not your Warlord, it still gains the benefit of this Warlord Trait. Additionally, your Warlord does not count as being slain unless both models in this unit are slain and removed from play.

rules.name: The Grim
rules.description: After deployment is concluded, any Infiltrator units have been placed down, if Lias Issodon is your warlord, you may redeploy up to 3 units in your army as if it were your deployment step. In addition, Lias Issodon may always Overwatch, even if his attached unit did not set to Overwatch.

sharedRules.name: None Wanting
sharedRules.description: All Blood Ravens units in your army have the Stubborn and Adamantium Will special rules.

sharedRules.name: Oath of Rynn’s world
sharedRules.description: Crimson Fist units may not Retreat in the Movement Phase.

sharedRules.name: Sanctioned Fratricide
sharedRules.description: Minotaur units gain the Preferred Enemy (Space Marines/ Chaos Space Marines). Enemy units engaged in combat with a Minotaur unit may not make Retreat Moves in the Movement Phase.

sharedRules.name: Blood in the Water
sharedRules.description: Carcharodon units are considered to have Furious Charge special rules when declaring a Charge against an enemy unit that has suffered an unsaved wound or casualty.

sharedRules.name: Return to the Void
sharedRules.description: A Carcharodon army gains the Expendable Keyword on all units at the start of the fifth battle round.

sharedRules.name: Raptor Hunt
sharedRules.description: Raptor Vanguard units gain +1 to their Ballistic Skill (BS) Characteristic. Raptor units in your army when performing a Retreat Move in the Movement Phase, move an additional 3”.

sharedRules.name: Orisons Occult
sharedRules.description: Exorcists units with the exception of Scout Squads and Scout Bikes gain the Preferred Enemy (Daemons) and Indomitable Will (5+) special rules.

sharedRules.name: Combat Squads
sharedRules.description: During Deployment, any Space marine unit of 10 models or 6 models with this rule with this special rule can split its squad in half, becoming two separate units. The unit must be split in half rounding up and are treated as separate units from that point on.

rules.name: Sub Commander
rules.comment: todo: Rule phrasing makes no sense in reference
rules.description: You may include 2 units with this special rule for each HQ slot in your army.

rules.name: Camo Cloaks
rules.description: A Model with a Camo Cloak gains the benefit of Light Cover even if they would not normally do so. In addition, if they are already benefiting from Light Cover, they receive heavy Cover instead. A model with this wargear gains a 4+ Cover save if it is already receiving the benefit of Heavy cover.

rules.name: Omni - Scrambler
rules.description: Enemy units may not arrive from reserves by any means within 18” of a model equipped with this wargear.

rules.name: Grapple Hooks
rules.description: A model with a Grapple Hook ignores vertical distances when moving as if they had the Fly Special Rule.

rules.name: Tempormortis
rules.description: At the start of the combat phase, enemy units in combat with a model equipped with this wargear have their Initiative reduced by 1.

rules.name: Grenade Harness
rules.description: A unit which includes a model with this wargear does not suffer the penalties of a Disordered Charge for Charging through Difficult Terrain.

rules.name: Scout Armour
rules.description: Basic Armour used by Space Marine Scout forces. It's lightweight and easy to move in. It provides a 4+ Armour save and gives the wearer the Scout, Outflank and Skirmisher special rules.

rules.name: Centurion Armour
rules.description: Centurion Armour is a massive, powered suit of Armour worn over normal power Armour. It provides a 2+ Armour save. In addition, it grants the wearer +1 to their Wound (W), Strength (S) and Toughness (T) characteristics, as well as the Relentless, Bulky (3) and Slow & Purposeful special rules. The wearers Movement (M) Characteristic is decreased by 2”A more mobile ancient pattern of Terminator Armour rarely used. It provides a 2+ Armour Save and a 5+ Invulnerable save. The Wearer gains Relentless, Bulky (2), and Sprint (1) special rules. It grants the Terminator Keyword.

rules.description: A model equipped with this relic wargear gains a 2+ Armour save and a 4+ Invulnerable save. In addition, the equipped model may re-roll 1 ailed Save (Armour or Invul) per phase.

rules.name: Honours Vehement

rules.name: The Imperium’s Sword

rules.name: Storm of Fire
rules.description:
Once per game during the shooting phase, your Warlord and any unit
they are attached to gains the Rending (5+) special rule on all of their shooting weapons until the end of that shooting phase.

rules.name: Rites of Battle
rules.description: If your Warlord has this trait, you can increase the number of Elite Slots, Fast Attack Slots or Heavy Support slots in your army by 1.

rules.name: Atomantic Shielding
rules.description: This confers a 5+ Invulnerable save. When a model with this wargear is slain and removed from play, the model suffers an Explodes result per the Vehicle damage chart before it is removed from play.
